title: sdks: unify auth/retries, improve streaming ergonomics, parity fixes across py/ts/go & bump v1.99.1
author: Aisha Khan
release_notes: v1.99.1: Unify auth/retries behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs; improve streaming API ergonomics and parity; bug fixes for edge-case token handling; minor docs/usage examples updated.
description:
Context: Over the past quarter we've had multiple inconsistencies between SDKs around auth token refresh behavior, retry backoff semantics, and streaming client ergonomics. This PR consolidates the shared retry/auth primitives into a single internal package, harmonizes streaming interfaces across Python/TS/Go, and applies parity fixes identified during cross-SDK e2e tests.

Motivation: reduce user confusion, avoid server-side churn from inconsistent retry semantics, and make developer-facing streaming APIs predictable and ergonomic.

Changes (high level):
- Extracted unified auth/retry core (common/retry_auth) and wired it into python/ts/go SDKs
- Streaming API ergonomics: unified on_event/on_chunk callbacks, consistent cancelation semantics, and improved backpressure handling
- Parity fixes: corrected field names and default params to match API contract (timeout, max_retries, metadata headers)
- Version bumps: python v1.99.1, typescript v1.99.1, go v1.99.1
- Docs: updated quickstarts and release notes

Checklist:
- [x] extract common primitives
- [x] update SDK implementations and tests
- [x] update docs and changelogs
- [x] run cross-SDK e2e harness
- [x] CI green

Commits (summary):
- a1b2c3d: add common retry/auth package and initial adapters
- b2c3d4e: python: adopt unified auth flow + streaming ergonomics changes
- c3d4e5f: typescript: unify streaming API surface and retry behavior
- d4e5f6a: go: apply parity fixes and expose consistent client options
- e5f6a7b: tests: add integration tests across SDKs

Files changed (high level):
- sdk/python/redwood/auth.py: refactor to use common/retry_auth
- sdk/python/redwood/streaming.py: API ergonomics and docs
- sdk/ts/src/auth.ts, sdk/ts/src/streaming.ts: parity and API alignment
- sdk/go/auth/*.go, sdk/go/streaming/*.go: parity + tests
- docs/quickstarts/sdks.md: examples updated
- build/packaging: bump package versions

CI and review: Initial CI run showed a flaky streaming test in the TS suite (timeout on CI runner). Fix applied (increase test timeout and add deterministic mock server), CI re-run passed.

Review conversation highlights:
- Diego: "Can we ensure the backoff defaults match existing server expectations?" — responded: backoff default kept at 200ms base with jitter; added comment and tests.
- Priya: "TS ergonomics look good, but ensure docstrings show cancel example" — responded: added example in quickstarts.
- Ethan: requested an explicit migration note for embedded customers using older retry configs — added migration section in changelog and retention in legacy adapter.

Risk & rollout: non-breaking for typical users; some customers who relied on old retry implicit defaults may see behaviour changes — migration notes added.

Monorepo impact: touching packaging and CI workflows to ensure parallel release of three SDKs.

Merge: squashed after approvals from reviewers and green CI.

Follow-ups:
- ENG-3605: add observability hooks for streaming performance
- ENG-3610: stability hardening for high-concurrency streaming (canary in perf lab)
